verdict.rationale: Lorikeet ships both a public REST-style API (api.lorikeetcx.ai) and an official MCP server that let AI clients diagnose tickets, audit knowledge bases, build/edit workflows, test tools, explore setup, and even create simulations — covering a broad swath of the UI's core workflows. However, the evidence doesn't confirm full parity for every UI feature (e.g., outbound consent/escalation configuration, Coach's Ticket Quality Score administration, or analytics dashboards) is programmatically accessible. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that ALL UI-only features (outbound campaign setup, quality scoring config, analytics/reporting) are also API/MCP accessible, and independent third-party verification of full parity.
